cards.ex: Make sure you lock the door.
Don't worry, it's no big deal.

quiz.q: The client needs the file — please send it ___ .
quiz.note: right away = 지금 바로. immediately의 회화 버전!

quiz.q: Sorry I'm late! — It's ___ , we just started.
quiz.note: It's no big deal = 별일 아니에요. 상대 마음을 풀어주는 말!
(That) sounds good — 3인칭 s 필수! 승낙의 만능 표현.
take your time = 서두르지 마세요. 배려의 한마디!

cards.ex: Thanks for coming on such short notice.
It'll save money in the long run.
You'll get the hang of it soon.
Sorry, it totally slipped my mind.
Can you keep an eye on my bag?

quiz.q: Thank you for helping us ___ such short notice.
quiz.note: on short notice = 급한 요청에도. 전치사 on!

quiz.q: Exercise costs time now but pays off ___ .
quiz.note: in the long run = 길게 보면. 장기 vs 단기 얘기의 필수 표현.

quiz.q: Driving feels hard at first, but you'll ___ of it.
quiz.note: get the hang of it = 감을 잡다. hang이 핵심!

quiz.q: I meant to call you, but it completely ___ my mind.
quiz.note: slip one's mind = 깜빡 잊다. 주어가 '그 일'이라는 게 포인트!

quiz.q: Could you ___ on the kids while I cook?
quiz.note: keep an eye on = 계속 지켜보다. 부탁할 때 최고 빈도!

cards.ex: A joke helps break the ice.
I'm still on the fence about the offer.

cards.expr: cost an arm and a leg
cards.ex: That bag costs an arm and a leg.
We burned the midnight oil to finish.
Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.

quiz.q: He told a funny story to ___ at the meeting.
quiz.hint: 얼음을 깨다 — 어색한 분위기를 푸는 표현
quiz.note: 첫 만남·회의 시작의 어색함을 깨는 것 = break the ice.

quiz.q: I can't decide yet — I'm still ___ about moving abroad.
quiz.hint: 울타리 위에 앉아 양쪽을 보는 중
quiz.note: on the fence = 이쪽도 저쪽도 결정 못 한 상태.

quiz.q: Rent in Gangnam ___ — it's incredibly expensive.
quiz.hint: 팔 하나와 다리 하나 값 (costs로 시작)
accept: costs an arm and a leg
costs an arm and a leg.
quiz.note: cost an arm and a leg = 팔다리를 내줄 만큼 비싸다!

quiz.q: We had to ___ to meet the deadline.
quiz.note: 전등 없던 시절 밤새 기름등을 태운 데서 — 야근·밤샘 작업.

quiz.q: Missing that flight was ___ — the plane had engine trouble.
quiz.note: a blessing in disguise = 전화위복. 나쁜 일이 알고 보니 행운!
